summary:
w147 reviewed: commit 3f97115 (8565af5 rebased, identical code), 8 files in the fileset, nothing under features/.
r77/r78 scenarios: 3 passed on HEAD. No test removed or weakened; no allowances claimed. check: ruff, vulture clean; size: none over 300.
Two Important fix-now findings:
F1: answers() runs once, before rounds/pull, so a gate round's or a worker's questions in the same run go to the person with exit 3 (contradicts r77; plan D6's repeat not done).
F2: a faulted answer session raises Refused with its stage dir, log lines and written answers uncommitted, so the next run is refused (r46) and the work-item never goes failed (r45).
Minor observations: an invalid-JSON quoted delegation crashes (F3); a delegation with a quote or newline breaks the by line (F4).
questions: Important, scripts/supervise.py:193 / scripts/supervise_answers.py:59: the answer pass runs once at the start of run(), so questions raised in the same run (gate round r69/r85, worker r5) go to the person with exit 3 instead of a session (r77; plan D6 not done)

Important, scripts/supervise_answers.py:85-96: a faulted answer session raises Refused leaving its stage dir, log.jsonl lines and written answers uncommitted, so the next work run is refused (r46) and the work-item is not moved to failed (r45)
